text: Free fighting game demo where you plan every move before the fight starts.
Queue your steps, guards and strikes on a timeline, then commit blind.
Your opponent does the same, and then you both watch the plans collide in real time.
There are over twenty fighters, each built around a weapon.
Best part: a ghost preview shows exactly what move you're locking in.
The catch? When the hits land, the animations feel a bit stiff.
The demo is about seven hundred megabytes, in English and Spanish.
Think Your Only Move Is Hustle, with swords.
Worth a dip if you'd rather outthink people than out-react them.
